description: App launches and displays the Home tab as the default selected tab with the Liquid Glass tab bar visible at the bottom
steps: Step 1: Launch the app from cold start
Step 2: Verify the app loads within 2 seconds
Step 3: Verify the Home tab is selected by default
Step 4: Verify the tab bar is visible at the bottom with 3 tabs: Home, My Shows, Profile
Step 5: Verify the tab bar uses Liquid Glass styling

description: Tab bar navigation switches between Home, My Shows, and Profile tabs correctly
steps: Step 1: Launch the app on the Home tab
Step 2: Tap the My Shows tab
Step 3: Verify the My Shows screen is displayed
Step 4: Tap the Profile tab
Step 5: Verify the Profile screen is displayed
Step 6: Tap the Home tab
Step 7: Verify the Home screen is displayed again with state preserved

description: Sign in with Apple authentication flow completes successfully and creates a user profile
steps: Step 1: Launch the app as an unauthenticated user
Step 2: Navigate to the Profile tab
Step 3: Tap the Sign in with Apple button
Step 4: Complete the Apple authentication sheet
Step 5: Verify the app creates a UserProfile with a default display name
Step 6: Verify the user is redirected to the Profile screen with their info
Step 7: Verify karma is initialized to 0
Step 8: Verify joined date is set to today

description: Email and password registration flow with email verification
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the sign up screen
Step 2: Enter a valid email address
Step 3: Enter a password meeting requirements
Step 4: Tap the Register button
Step 5: Verify a verification email is sent
Step 6: Verify the user sees a prompt to verify their email
Step 7: Simulate email verification
Step 8: Verify the user can now sign in with the email and password
Step 9: Verify a UserProfile is created in Firestore

description: Google Sign-In authentication flow completes and creates a profile
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the sign in screen
Step 2: Tap the Google Sign-In button
Step 3: Complete the Google authentication flow
Step 4: Verify a UserProfile is created
Step 5: Verify the user is signed in and can access authenticated features

description: Biometric unlock (Face ID / Touch ID) works for returning sessions
steps: Step 1: Sign in with any method
Step 2: Close and relaunch the app
Step 3: Verify the biometric prompt appears
Step 4: Authenticate with Face ID or Touch ID
Step 5: Verify the user is signed in without re-entering credentials

description: Unauthenticated users can browse shows and read threads but cannot comment, vote, or save
steps: Step 1: Launch the app without signing in
Step 2: Navigate to the Home tab and verify content loads
Step 3: Tap a show card and verify Show Detail loads
Step 4: Tap an episode and verify the thread loads with comments visible
Step 5: Attempt to tap the compose bar and verify a sign-in prompt appears
Step 6: Attempt to tap a vote arrow and verify a sign-in prompt appears
Step 7: Attempt to save a show and verify a sign-in prompt appears
Step 8: Navigate to My Shows tab and verify sign-in prompt is shown
Step 9: Navigate to Profile tab and verify sign-in options are displayed

description: Home tab Trending Now carousel displays 5-10 cards with highest comment velocity
steps: Step 1: Sign in and navigate to the Home tab
Step 2: Verify the Trending Now section is visible at the top
Step 3: Verify it displays between 5 and 10 show cards
Step 4: Verify each card shows: backdrop image, show title, episode label, comment count
Step 5: Scroll the carousel horizontally and verify smooth scrolling
Step 6: Tap a trending card and verify navigation to the episode thread

description: Home tab From Your Watchlist section shows unvisited threads for followed shows
steps: Step 1: Save at least 3 shows to the watchlist
Step 2: Navigate to the Home tab
Step 3: Verify the From Your Watchlist section is visible
Step 4: Verify it shows episode threads for followed shows sorted by air date
Step 5: Verify unread indicator dots are visible on unvisited threads
Step 6: Tap a thread and verify navigation to the episode thread
Step 7: Return to Home and verify the unread dot is removed for the visited thread

description: Home tab shows empty state when no shows are saved to watchlist
steps: Step 1: Sign in with a fresh account (no saved shows)
Step 2: Navigate to the Home tab
Step 3: Verify the From Your Watchlist section shows the empty state message
Step 4: Verify the message reads 'Save shows to see discussions here.'
Step 5: Verify there is a way to navigate to search/discover shows

description: Home tab Recently Aired section shows threads for episodes aired in last 48 hours
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the Home tab
Step 2: Verify the Recently Aired section is visible
Step 3: Verify it shows threads sorted by comment count (most active first)
Step 4: Verify each row shows: poster, show title, episode title, air date, comment count
Step 5: Verify it includes shows the user does NOT follow (discovery)

description: Home tab Discover section shows editorial picks and breakout shows
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the Home tab
Step 2: Scroll down to the Discover section
Step 3: Verify show cards are displayed
Step 4: Verify shows have high engagement-to-follower ratio
Step 5: Tap a discover card and verify navigation to Show Detail

description: Home tab pull-to-refresh reloads all feed sections
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the Home tab
Step 2: Pull down on the scroll view
Step 3: Verify a Liquid Glass progress indicator appears
Step 4: Verify all sections reload with fresh data
Step 5: Verify the refresh indicator dismisses when loading completes

description: Search from Home tab finds shows and movies via TMDB search/multi endpoint
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the Home tab
Step 2: Tap the search bar below the navigation bar
Step 3: Verify a full-screen search experience opens
Step 4: Type 'Breaking Bad' into the search field
Step 5: Verify results appear within 1 second
Step 6: Verify results show as show cards with poster, title, year, network
Step 7: Tap a result and verify navigation to Show Detail
Step 8: Return to search and verify 'Breaking Bad' appears in recent searches

description: Search displays trending searches when the search field is empty
steps: Step 1: Open the search screen
Step 2: Verify trending searches are displayed when the field is empty
Step 3: Tap a trending search term
Step 4: Verify the search executes and results are displayed

description: Search debounces input at 300ms to avoid excessive API calls
steps: Step 1: Open the search screen
Step 2: Type rapidly into the search field
Step 3: Verify the search does not fire on every keystroke
Step 4: Wait 300ms after stopping typing
Step 5: Verify results appear after the debounce period

description: Show Detail page loads and displays all metadata from TMDB
steps: Step 1: Search for a TV show (e.g., 'Severance')
Step 2: Tap the show in search results
Step 3: Verify the Show Detail page loads
Step 4: Verify hero backdrop image is displayed (16:9 with gradient fade)
Step 5: Verify title, year range, network, genres (as glass chips), TMDB rating, and airing status are shown
Step 6: Verify streaming availability links appear as Liquid Glass pills
Step 7: Verify a Save/status button is present
Step 8: Verify a season selector with horizontal glass pills is shown
Step 9: Verify the episode list for the first season loads with episode number, title, air date, comment count, and still image
Step 10: Verify switching seasons updates the episode list
Step 11: Tap an episode and verify navigation to the Episode Thread

description: Show Detail page handles movies correctly with single-season single-episode normalization
steps: Step 1: Search for a movie (e.g., 'Oppenheimer')
Step 2: Tap the movie in search results
Step 3: Verify the Show Detail page loads with movie metadata
Step 4: Verify there is no season selector or it shows a single season
Step 5: Verify there is exactly one episode entry representing the movie
Step 6: Tap the episode and verify the Episode Thread opens
Step 7: Verify the thread shows movie-appropriate metadata (runtime, release date)

description: Season selector on Show Detail page switches between seasons and loads episodes
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Show Detail for a multi-season show
Step 2: Verify Season 1 is selected by default
Step 3: Tap Season 2 in the horizontal glass pill selector
Step 4: Verify the episode list updates to show Season 2 episodes
Step 5: Verify episode stills are prefetched for the selected season
Step 6: Tap Season 1 again and verify the list reverts

description: Streaming availability links display platform logos and open apps or web URLs
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Show Detail for a popular show with streaming links
Step 2: Verify streaming platform logos appear as tappable Liquid Glass pills
Step 3: Verify the correct platforms are shown (e.g., Netflix, Hulu)
Step 4: Tap a streaming link
Step 5: Verify it attempts to open the app via universal link or falls back to web URL
Step 6: Verify streaming links are region-aware

description: Episode Thread page loads with episode header, sort control, and comment tree
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread from Show Detail
Step 2: Verify the episode header shows: still image, title, S/E label, air date, runtime
Step 3: Verify the overview is expandable (collapsed to 3 lines by default)
Step 4: Tap the overview to expand it and verify full text appears
Step 5: Verify the sort control is visible below the header (Liquid Glass segmented)
Step 6: Verify the comment tree loads below the sort control
Step 7: Verify the floating compose bar is visible at the bottom
Step 8: Verify the 'Where to Watch' streaming row is present (collapsed by default)
Step 9: Expand the streaming row and verify links appear
Step 10: Verify the default sort order is 'Hot'

description: Comment tree renders nested comments with proper indentation up to depth 5
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread with nested comments
Step 2: Verify top-level comments have 0pt indentation
Step 3: Verify reply comments are indented 16pt per nesting level
Step 4: Verify each comment shows: avatar (24pt), display name, karma badge, timestamp, body, vote arrows + score, reply button
Step 5: Verify nesting stops at depth 5 (max 80pt indentation)
Step 6: Verify deeply nested replies at depth 5+ do not indent further

description: Collapsed thread indicator shows and expands additional replies
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread with long comment chains
Step 2: Verify collapsed thread indicators appear (e.g., '12 more replies')
Step 3: Tap the collapsed indicator
Step 4: Verify the hidden replies expand and are visible
Step 5: Verify the expanded replies maintain proper nesting and indentation

description: Posting a new top-level comment via the compose bar
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread as an authenticated user
Step 2: Tap the floating compose bar ('Join the discussion...')
Step 3: Verify it expands into a full glass sheet with multiline text editor
Step 4: Type a comment text
Step 5: Tap the submit button
Step 6: Verify the sheet dismisses
Step 7: Verify the new comment appears in the thread with optimistic UI (<50ms)
Step 8: Verify the comment shows the user's avatar, name, karma, and timestamp
Step 9: Verify the comment count increments on the episode
Step 10: Verify the comment is persisted to Firestore
Step 11: Verify the comment appears when refreshing the thread

description: Replying to an existing comment creates a nested reply
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread with existing comments
Step 2: Tap the 'Reply' button on a comment
Step 3: Verify the composer opens pre-filled with parent context
Step 4: Type a reply
Step 5: Tap submit
Step 6: Verify the reply appears nested under the parent comment
Step 7: Verify the reply has depth = parent.depth + 1
Step 8: Verify proper indentation is applied

description: Editing an existing comment updates the text and shows edited timestamp
steps: Step 1: Navigate to a thread containing your own comment
Step 2: Long-press or use the edit action on your comment
Step 3: Verify the comment text is editable
Step 4: Modify the text and save
Step 5: Verify the comment displays the updated text
Step 6: Verify an 'edited' indicator appears with the edit timestamp
Step 7: Verify the edit is persisted to Firestore

description: Deleting a comment marks it as deleted and preserves thread integrity
steps: Step 1: Navigate to a thread containing your own comment
Step 2: Use the delete action on your comment
Step 3: Confirm the deletion
Step 4: Verify the comment body is replaced with '[deleted]' or similar
Step 5: Verify the comment's isDeleted flag is true in Firestore
Step 6: Verify replies to the deleted comment are still visible

description: Upvoting a comment increments the score and updates karma
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread with comments from other users
Step 2: Note the current net score on a comment
Step 3: Tap the upvote arrow
Step 4: Verify the net score increments by 1 (optimistic update <50ms)
Step 5: Verify a bounce animation plays on the upvote arrow
Step 6: Verify light haptic feedback is triggered
Step 7: Verify the commenter's karma increases by 1
Step 8: Verify a Vote document is created in Firestore with value=+1

description: Downvoting a comment decrements the score and updates karma
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread
Step 2: Tap the downvote arrow on a comment
Step 3: Verify the net score decrements by 1
Step 4: Verify a bounce animation and haptic play
Step 5: Verify the commenter's karma decreases by 1
Step 6: Verify a Vote document is created with value=-1

description: Removing a vote by tapping the same arrow again returns to neutral
steps: Step 1: Upvote a comment
Step 2: Verify the score is incremented
Step 3: Tap the upvote arrow again
Step 4: Verify the score returns to the original value
Step 5: Verify the Vote document is deleted from Firestore

description: Switching vote from upvote to downvote correctly updates the score by -2
steps: Step 1: Upvote a comment (score +1)
Step 2: Tap the downvote arrow
Step 3: Verify the net score changes by -2 from the upvoted state
Step 4: Verify the Vote document is updated to value=-1

description: Users cannot vote on their own comments
steps: Step 1: Post a comment in an Episode Thread
Step 2: Attempt to tap the upvote or downvote arrow on your own comment
Step 3: Verify the vote is not registered
Step 4: Verify the vote arrows are disabled or hidden for own comments

description: Comment sort mode Hot orders by Wilson score weighted by recency
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread with multiple comments
Step 2: Select 'Hot' sort mode
Step 3: Verify comments are ordered by a combination of upvotes and recency
Step 4: Verify a highly upvoted recent comment appears above an older equally-upvoted one
Step 5: Verify a new comment with few votes does not immediately jump to the top

description: Comment sort mode Top orders by highest net upvotes with time sub-filters
steps: Step 1: Select 'Top' sort mode
Step 2: Verify comments are ordered by highest net score (upvotes minus downvotes)
Step 3: Select sub-filter 'Today'
Step 4: Verify only comments from today are shown, ordered by score
Step 5: Select sub-filter 'This Week'
Step 6: Verify comments from the past 7 days, ordered by score
Step 7: Select sub-filter 'All Time'
Step 8: Verify all comments, ordered by score

description: Comment sort mode New orders by reverse chronological
steps: Step 1: Select 'New' sort mode
Step 2: Verify comments are ordered newest first
Step 3: Post a new comment
Step 4: Verify the new comment appears at the top of the list

description: Comment sort mode Controversial surfaces divisive comments
steps: Step 1: Select 'Controversial' sort mode
Step 2: Verify comments with high total votes but near-zero net score appear first
Step 3: Verify a comment with 50 upvotes and 49 downvotes ranks above a comment with 2 upvotes and 0 downvotes

description: Spoiler tag syntax renders as blurred block and reveals on tap
steps: Step 1: Post a comment containing >!spoiler text!< syntax
Step 2: Verify the spoiler text renders as a blurred/hidden block
Step 3: Tap the blurred block
Step 4: Verify the spoiler text is revealed
Step 5: Verify non-spoiler text around it renders normally

description: Episode threads for recently aired episodes show a spoiler warning banner
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread for an episode that aired less than 48 hours ago
Step 2: Verify a prominent spoiler warning banner is displayed at the top of the thread
Step 3: Navigate to an Episode Thread for an episode that aired more than 48 hours ago
Step 4: Verify no spoiler warning banner is shown

description: Season-gated spoiler protection hides threads beyond the user's caught-up point
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile > Settings > Spoiler Protection
Step 2: Set 'caught up through' to Season 2 Episode 5 for a show
Step 3: Navigate to the Show Detail for that show
Step 4: Verify episodes S2E6+ show a spoiler gate requiring confirmation
Step 5: Tap the gate and confirm to proceed
Step 6: Verify the Episode Thread loads after confirmation

description: My Shows tab displays saved shows grouped by status with correct segment control
steps: Step 1: Save several shows with different statuses (Watching, Plan to Watch, Completed)
Step 2: Navigate to the My Shows tab
Step 3: Verify 'Currently Watching' is selected by default
Step 4: Verify shows with status 'watching' are listed
Step 5: Tap 'Plan to Watch' segment
Step 6: Verify shows with status 'planToWatch' are listed
Step 7: Tap 'Completed' segment
Step 8: Verify shows with status 'completed' are listed
Step 9: Verify each show card displays: poster, title, network, genre tags
Step 10: Verify 'Currently Watching' shows display next episode air date countdown
Step 11: Verify unread thread count badges are visible

description: Adding a show to the watchlist from the search/add flow on My Shows tab
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the My Shows tab
Step 2: Tap the search bar or the '+' FAB
Step 3: Search for a show (e.g., 'The Bear')
Step 4: Tap a result
Step 5: Verify a bottom sheet appears with status options: Watching, Plan to Watch, Completed
Step 6: Select 'Currently Watching'
Step 7: Verify the show appears in the Currently Watching list
Step 8: Verify a WatchlistEntry is created in Firestore
Step 9: Verify notifications are enabled by default for this show

description: Adding a show to watchlist from the Show Detail page Save button
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Show Detail for a show not yet saved
Step 2: Tap the 'Save to Watchlist' button
Step 3: Verify a status selection appears
Step 4: Select a status
Step 5: Verify the button changes to show the current status
Step 6: Navigate to My Shows and verify the show appears in the correct segment

description: Quick-save via bookmark icon on show cards throughout the app
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the Home tab
Step 2: Find a show card with a bookmark icon
Step 3: Tap the bookmark icon
Step 4: Verify a bounce animation and medium haptic feedback
Step 5: Verify the show is added to the watchlist with default status 'Currently Watching'
Step 6: Navigate to My Shows and verify the show appears

description: Changing a show's watchlist status via long-press context menu
steps: Step 1: Navigate to My Shows with a saved show
Step 2: Long-press the show card
Step 3: Verify a context menu appears with: Change Status, Mute Notifications, Remove
Step 4: Tap 'Change Status'
Step 5: Select a new status (e.g., 'Completed')
Step 6: Verify the show moves to the Completed segment with animation
Step 7: Verify the WatchlistEntry is updated in Firestore

description: Removing a show from watchlist via swipe-left action
steps: Step 1: Navigate to My Shows
Step 2: Swipe left on a show card
Step 3: Verify a red 'Remove' action appears
Step 4: Tap Remove
Step 5: Verify haptic confirmation
Step 6: Verify the show is removed from the list
Step 7: Verify the WatchlistEntry is deleted from Firestore
Step 8: Verify the user is unsubscribed from notifications for this show

description: My Shows sort by Most Recent Activity, Alphabetical, and Next Airing
steps: Step 1: Save 5+ shows to watchlist
Step 2: Open the sort dropdown on My Shows
Step 3: Select 'Most Recent Activity' and verify shows are sorted by newest thread activity
Step 4: Select 'Alphabetical' and verify A–Z order
Step 5: Select 'Next Airing' and verify shows with soonest upcoming episodes are first

description: My Shows empty state when no shows are saved
steps: Step 1: Sign in with a fresh account
Step 2: Navigate to the My Shows tab
Step 3: Verify an illustration and text 'Your watchlist is empty' are displayed
Step 4: Verify a prominent search button is shown
Step 5: Tap the search button and verify the search flow opens

description: My Shows empty state for specific status segment
steps: Step 1: Save shows only in 'Currently Watching' status
Step 2: Navigate to My Shows and tap 'Plan to Watch'
Step 3: Verify 'No shows here yet.' text is displayed
Step 4: Tap 'Completed' and verify the same empty state

description: Profile screen displays user header with avatar, name, bio, karma, and stats
steps: Step 1: Sign in and navigate to the Profile tab
Step 2: Verify the avatar is displayed as an 80pt circular image
Step 3: Verify the display name is shown
Step 4: Verify the bio is displayed (or placeholder if empty)
Step 5: Verify the karma score is shown with an upvote icon
Step 6: Verify the joined date is shown
Step 7: Verify the show count is shown (e.g., 'Tracking 12 shows')

description: Editing profile display name with validation
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile
Step 2: Tap the display name to edit
Step 3: Enter a new valid name (3–20 chars, alphanumeric + underscores)
Step 4: Save and verify the name updates
Step 5: Try entering an invalid name (<3 chars or special characters)
Step 6: Verify validation error is shown
Step 7: Try entering a name that's already taken
Step 8: Verify uniqueness error is shown

description: Editing profile bio with 160 character limit
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile
Step 2: Tap the bio to edit
Step 3: Enter text under 160 characters and save
Step 4: Verify the bio updates
Step 5: Try entering text over 160 characters
Step 6: Verify input is truncated or limited at 160 characters

description: Changing profile avatar via camera, photo library, or curated defaults
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile
Step 2: Tap the avatar image
Step 3: Verify options appear: camera, photo library, curated defaults
Step 4: Select a curated default avatar
Step 5: Verify the avatar updates immediately
Step 6: Verify the new avatar URL is saved to Firestore

description: Karma breakdown tooltip shows total upvotes, downvotes, and net
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile
Step 2: Tap the karma score
Step 3: Verify a breakdown tooltip appears showing total upvotes received, total downvotes received, and net karma
Step 4: Verify the numbers are consistent

description: Comment history on Profile shows paginated comments with navigation to threads
steps: Step 1: Post several comments in different episode threads
Step 2: Navigate to Profile > Comment History
Step 3: Verify comments are listed most recent first
Step 4: Verify each row shows: show title, episode label, comment preview (2 lines), timestamp, net votes
Step 5: Tap a comment and verify navigation to the episode thread
Step 6: Verify the thread scrolls to the tapped comment
Step 7: Scroll down the comment history and verify pagination loads more comments

description: In-app notifications appear for replies to user's comments
steps: Step 1: Post a comment in a thread
Step 2: Have another user reply to your comment
Step 3: Navigate to Profile > Notifications
Step 4: Verify a notification appears for the reply
Step 5: Verify the notification is grouped by show
Step 6: Tap the notification and verify navigation to the comment
Step 7: Verify the badge on the Profile tab clears after reading

description: Push notification for new episode thread on followed show
steps: Step 1: Follow a show that is currently airing
Step 2: Simulate a new episode being added via the Cloud Function
Step 3: Verify a push notification is delivered with the correct content
Step 4: Tap the push notification
Step 5: Verify the app opens and deep-links to the new episode thread

description: Notification preferences allow toggling replies, new episodes, trending, and karma
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile > Settings > Notification Preferences
Step 2: Toggle off 'Replies'
Step 3: Have another user reply to your comment
Step 4: Verify no push or in-app notification is generated for the reply
Step 5: Toggle 'Replies' back on
Step 6: Verify notifications resume for new replies

description: Per-show notification muting via My Shows context menu
steps: Step 1: Long-press a show in My Shows
Step 2: Tap 'Mute Notifications'
Step 3: Verify the show remains in the watchlist but notifications are disabled
Step 4: Verify no push notifications for new episodes of this show
Step 5: Verify the mute is reflected in WatchlistEntry.notificationsEnabled=false

description: Quiet hours setting blocks notifications during configured time window
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Settings > Notifications > Quiet Hours
Step 2: Set quiet hours from 10 PM to 7 AM
Step 3: Simulate a notification trigger during quiet hours
Step 4: Verify the notification is not delivered during quiet hours
Step 5: Verify the notification is delivered after quiet hours end

description: Appearance setting switches between system, light, and dark mode
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile > Settings > Appearance
Step 2: Select 'Dark' mode
Step 3: Verify the entire app switches to dark mode
Step 4: Select 'Light' mode and verify light appearance
Step 5: Select 'System' and verify it follows the device setting

description: Sign out flow clears session and returns to unauthenticated state
steps: Step 1: Sign in to the app
Step 2: Navigate to Profile > Settings > Account > Sign Out
Step 3: Confirm sign out
Step 4: Verify the app returns to the unauthenticated state
Step 5: Verify the Profile tab shows sign-in options
Step 6: Verify cached user-specific data is cleared

description: Delete account flow removes all user data and anonymizes comments
steps: Step 1: Sign in and post some comments
Step 2: Navigate to Profile > Settings > Account > Delete Account
Step 3: Confirm deletion
Step 4: Verify the UserProfile is deleted from Firestore
Step 5: Verify WatchlistEntries are deleted
Step 6: Verify comments are anonymized (author info cleared) but comment text preserved for thread integrity
Step 7: Verify the user is signed out

description: Reporting a comment with category selection
steps: Step 1: Long-press a comment in a thread
Step 2: Tap 'Report'
Step 3: Verify report categories appear: spam, harassment, spoilers, off-topic
Step 4: Select a category and confirm
Step 5: Verify a report is submitted
Step 6: Verify the user sees a confirmation message

description: Muting a user hides all their comments from the muter's view
steps: Step 1: Navigate to a thread with comments from a specific user
Step 2: Long-press a comment from that user
Step 3: Tap 'Mute User'
Step 4: Verify all comments from that user disappear from the thread
Step 5: Navigate to a different thread and verify comments from the muted user are hidden there too

description: Blocking a user prevents them from replying to the blocker's comments
steps: Step 1: Block a user via the mute/block flow
Step 2: Verify all of the blocked user's comments are hidden
Step 3: Simulate the blocked user trying to reply to the blocker's comment
Step 4: Verify Firestore security rules prevent the reply from being written

description: Perspective API toxicity filter holds high-toxicity comments for review
steps: Step 1: Submit a comment with clearly toxic content
Step 2: Verify the comment is flagged by Perspective API (score > 0.8)
Step 3: Verify the comment is not published to the thread
Step 4: Verify the comment is queued for moderator review

description: Real-time comments appear in the thread without manual refresh
steps: Step 1: Open an Episode Thread on Device A
Step 2: Post a new comment from Device B in the same thread
Step 3: Verify the comment appears on Device A in real-time via Firestore listener
Step 4: Verify the comment slides in with a move + opacity animation

description: Real-time vote count updates on comments without refresh
steps: Step 1: Open a thread with comments
Step 2: Have another user upvote a comment
Step 3: Verify the vote count updates in real-time on the viewer's screen

description: Offline browsing of previously visited shows and cached metadata
steps: Step 1: Visit a Show Detail page and several episode threads while online
Step 2: Disable network connectivity
Step 3: Navigate to My Shows and verify the watchlist loads from SwiftData cache
Step 4: Tap a cached show and verify Show Detail loads with cached metadata and images
Step 5: Verify a staleness indicator is shown
Step 6: Navigate to a cached episode thread and verify comments are visible (cached)

description: Offline comment drafts are persisted and synced when connectivity returns
steps: Step 1: Disable network connectivity
Step 2: Open the compose bar in an Episode Thread
Step 3: Type a comment and tap submit
Step 4: Verify the draft is saved locally
Step 5: Re-enable network connectivity
Step 6: Verify the comment is automatically submitted to Firestore
Step 7: Verify the comment appears in the thread

description: Offline votes are queued and replayed when connectivity returns
steps: Step 1: Disable network connectivity
Step 2: Upvote a cached comment
Step 3: Verify the vote is reflected optimistically in the UI
Step 4: Re-enable network connectivity
Step 5: Verify the Vote is synced to Firestore

description: TMDB data caching with 6-hour TTL and stale refresh
steps: Step 1: Visit a Show Detail page (data is cached)
Step 2: Verify the data loads from cache on subsequent visits within 6 hours
Step 3: Wait or simulate 6+ hours since lastRefreshed
Step 4: Visit the Show Detail page again
Step 5: Verify a background refresh is triggered from TMDB
Step 6: Verify the UI updates with fresh data

description: TMDB API failure gracefully degrades to cached data with banner
steps: Step 1: Visit a show to cache its data
Step 2: Simulate a TMDB API failure
Step 3: Navigate to the show again
Step 4: Verify cached data is displayed
Step 5: Verify a 'Content may be outdated' banner appears

description: Deep link showthread://show/{tmdbId}/season/{n}/episode/{n} opens correct thread
steps: Step 1: Open a deep link URL in the format showthread://show/1399/season/5/episode/14
Step 2: Verify the app launches (or foregrounds)
Step 3: Verify the Episode Thread for the specified episode opens
Step 4: Verify the correct show, season, and episode content is displayed

description: Push notification deep-link navigates to the correct comment in a thread
steps: Step 1: Receive a push notification for a reply to your comment
Step 2: Tap the notification
Step 3: Verify the app opens the Episode Thread containing the reply
Step 4: Verify the thread scrolls to the reply comment

description: Comment pagination loads batches of 50 comments with cursor-based queries
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread with 100+ comments
Step 2: Verify the initial batch of 50 comments loads

description: Show followerCount increments when a user saves and decrements when removed

description: Episode commentCount denormalized field stays in sync with actual comment documents

description: End-to-end flow: new user signs up, searches show, saves to watchlist, reads thread, posts comment, votes, and receives reply notification

Step 13: Submit the comment and verify it appears in the thread
Step 14: Upvote another users comment and verify score changes

Step 17: Tap the notification and verify navigation to the reply in the thread

description: End-to-end flow: manage watchlist lifecycle add show, change status through watching to completed, remove
steps: Step 1: Navigate to My Shows tab
Step 2: Tap the + FAB to open search
Step 3: Search for a show and add it as Plan to Watch
Step 4: Verify it appears under Plan to Watch segment
Step 5: Long-press the show and select Change Status to Currently Watching
Step 6: Verify it moves to the Currently Watching segment with animation
Step 7: Verify notifications are enabled for this show
Step 8: Long-press again and change to Completed
Step 9: Verify it moves to Completed segment
Step 10: Swipe left on the show and tap Remove
Step 11: Verify haptic confirmation and the show is removed
Step 12: Navigate to My Shows and verify it no longer appears in any segment
Step 13: Verify the WatchlistEntry is deleted from Firestore

description: End-to-end flow: comment thread interaction post, reply, edit, delete, sort, and paginate
steps: Step 1: Navigate to an Episode Thread
Step 2: Post a top-level comment via the compose bar
Step 3: Verify the comment appears immediately (optimistic)
Step 4: Reply to another users comment
Step 5: Verify the reply appears nested under the parent
Step 6: Edit your top-level comment text
Step 7: Verify the edited indicator appears
Step 8: Delete your reply
Step 9: Verify the reply shows [deleted] but parent/sibling comments remain
Step 10: Switch sort to Top and verify re-ordering
Step 11: Switch sort to New and verify reverse chronological
Step 12: Scroll to the bottom to trigger pagination
Step 13: Verify additional comments load without duplicates

description: End-to-end flow: voting lifecycle upvote, switch to downvote, remove vote, verify karma impact
steps: Step 1: Navigate to a thread and note a comments score and authors karma
Step 2: Upvote the comment
Step 3: Verify score +1, author karma +1, bounce animation, light haptic
Step 4: Tap downvote (switching vote)
Step 5: Verify score is now -1 from original, author karma -1 from original
Step 6: Tap downvote again to remove the vote
Step 7: Verify score returns to original, author karma returns to original
Step 8: Verify the Vote document is deleted from Firestore
Step 9: Attempt to vote on your own comment and verify its blocked
Step 10: Verify only one Vote document exists per user per comment at any time

description: End-to-end flow: offline mode browse cached data, queue actions, sync on reconnect
steps: Step 1: While online, visit a Show Detail and Episode Thread to cache data
Step 2: Save the show to watchlist while online
Step 3: Disable network connectivity
Step 4: Navigate to My Shows and verify watchlist loads from cache
Step 5: Navigate to the cached Show Detail and verify it loads
Step 6: Enter the cached Episode Thread and verify cached comments display
Step 7: Verify a staleness indicator is shown
Step 8: Post a comment (queued in offline outbox)
Step 9: Upvote a comment (queued in offline outbox)
Step 10: Re-enable network connectivity
Step 11: Verify the comment is synced to Firestore
Step 12: Verify the vote is synced to Firestore
Step 13: Verify no duplicates were created

description: End-to-end flow: spoiler protection lifecycle set caught-up, encounter gate, reveal spoiler tags
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile Settings Spoiler Protection

Step 3: Navigate to that shows Detail page
Step 4: Verify episodes S2E1-E5 are accessible without gates
Step 5: Tap episode S2E6
Step 6: Verify a spoiler gate appears requiring confirmation
Step 7: Confirm and verify the thread loads
Step 8: View a comment with spoiler syntax
Step 9: Verify the spoiler text is blurred
Step 10: Tap to reveal and verify the text is shown
Step 11: Navigate to an episode aired less than 48h ago
Step 12: Verify the spoiler warning banner is displayed prominently

description: End-to-end flow: profile management edit name, bio, avatar, check karma breakdown, view history
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile tab
Step 2: Tap display name and change it to a valid unique name
Step 3: Verify the name updates on screen and in Firestore
Step 4: Tap bio and add text (under 160 chars)
Step 5: Verify bio updates
Step 6: Tap avatar and select a curated default
Step 7: Verify avatar updates visually and in Firestore
Step 8: Tap karma score and verify breakdown tooltip (up, down, net)
Step 9: Scroll to Comment History and verify paginated comments

description: End-to-end flow: notification settings toggle preferences, test per-show mute, configure quiet hours
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Profile Settings Notifications
Step 2: Toggle off New Episodes notifications
Step 3: Simulate a new episode for a followed show
Step 4: Verify no notification is received
Step 5: Toggle New Episodes back on

Step 8: Verify no notification for the muted show but notifications work for other followed shows

description: End-to-end flow: moderation report comment, mute user, block user, verify isolation
steps: Step 1: Navigate to a thread with comments from various users
Step 2: Long-press a comment and tap Report
Step 3: Select Harassment category and confirm
Step 4: Verify confirmation message shown
Step 5: Long-press another comment from a user and tap Mute User

Step 8: Block a different user
Step 9: Verify their comments are hidden
Step 10: Simulate the blocked user trying to reply to your comment
Step 11: Verify Firestore security rules reject the reply

description: End-to-end flow: search and discovery search shows, browse results, use trending, check recent searches
steps: Step 1: Open search from Home tab
Step 2: Verify trending searches are displayed when field is empty

Step 4: Clear and type a custom query Stranger Things
Step 5: Wait 300ms debounce and verify results appear within 1 second

Step 7: Tap a result to open Show Detail
Step 8: Navigate back to search

description: End-to-end flow: deep linking open app via URL scheme, navigate to correct thread, handle missing content

description: End-to-end visual consistency: all glass components maintain visual harmony across screens in light mode

description: End-to-end flow: account deletion and data cleanup verification
